research_question: What period-specific BPS evidence constrains the sampling and population-estimation mechanism of the annual construction survey around the 2005 revision window, without overstating a causal link to the historical revision?

source.title: Kegiatan BPS Tahun 2004-2009 dan Rencana Kegiatan BPS Tahun 2010
source.bps_authored_artifact_surface: mirror retaining original bps.go.id page markings and embedded BPS publication metadata

annual_construction_survey_method.sample_selection_method: combination of cut-off point and stratified PPS sampling
annual_construction_survey_method.population_estimation_rule: For each characteristic, population estimates use company qualification as the basis of the expansion factor.
annual_construction_survey_method.qualification_definition: Company qualification represents capability to handle construction projects according to contract value.

historical_respondent_counts.source_table: Tabel 5.5. Jumlah Responden Survei Industri dan Konstruksi Tahun 2004-2009

mechanism_candidate_effect.status_change_scope: evidence-strength refinement only; no causal authorization
new_support: BPS retrospectively documents an annual construction survey design using cut-off point plus stratified PPS sampling for the 2004-2009 operational period.
BPS retrospectively documents qualification as the basis of the expansion factor for annual construction population estimates.
BPS records 8,168 annual construction survey respondents in 2005.
The report's approximate 80,000 active-company universe is numerically consistent with the approximate universe reported for the 2005 directory-updating metadata.
remaining_causal_gaps: no contemporaneous 2005/2006 revision note linking revised 2001-2003 values to the directory refresh
no proof that the refreshed directory replaced the exact frame used to recompute the revised historical years
no Sumatera Barat old/new qualification-stratum frame counts
no contemporaneous old/new weights or expansion factors for Sumatera Barat
no reproducible transformation from old-vintage to revised-vintage values
